entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: State where an EMM context has been established and a default EPS bearer context may be activated. UE location is known to MME with tracking area list accuracy in EMM-IDLE mode and serving eNodeB accuracy in EMM-CONNECTED mode.

entities.name: Default EPS bearer context
entities.description: Activated context in UE when EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is not supported or when UE requests PDN connectivity and bearer is successfully established.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection support condition
entities.description: Condition where EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is not supported by UE or MME, or UE requests PDN connectivity and default EPS bearer is established.

entities.name: Tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure performed in EMM-REGISTERED state for updating UE tracking area.

entities.name: EMM-IDLE mode
entities.description: Mode where UE location is known to MME with tracking area list accuracy.

entities.name: EMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: Mode where UE location is known to MME with serving eNodeB accuracy.

relations.description: EMM-REGISTERED state establishes an EMM context.
EMM-REGISTERED state may establish a default EPS bearer context under specified conditions.
Condition guards activation of default EPS bearer context in EMM-REGISTERED state.
EMM-REGISTERED state includes performing tracking area updating procedure.
EMM-REGISTERED state includes EMM-IDLE mode with tracking area list location accuracy.
EMM-REGISTERED state includes EMM-CONNECTED mode with serving eNodeB location accuracy.
